title: DNS Extensions to Support IP Version 6
summary: Defines the changes the Domain Name System needs so that hosts running IPv6 can be found by name. It introduces a new record type for IPv6 addresses and a way to look up a name from an IPv6 address. It was replaced by RFC 3596.

eli5.summary: The phone book only had room for short old-style numbers. This added a new kind of entry for the much longer new numbers, so you can still look up a friend by name.
